evals.name: bare-facts-still-get-source-checks
evals.prompt: Audit the supplied llms-facts.txt fixture without a source mirror and with network/indexing unavailable. One row uses upload://notes/a.md#limit as its source, and another is an unresolved question placed in Facts. Do not treat missing mirror access as a grammar exemption.
evals.expected_output: P7 source/non-factual placement findings remain visible, anchor/source-truth limitations are unavailable evidence, and no live-probe pass is invented.

assertions.name: p7-runs-without-a-mirror
assertions.check: The custom source scheme is reported High and the unresolved question is not accepted as settled Facts.

assertions.name: missing-access-is-not-a-pass
assertions.check: Anchor truth and live retrieval remain N/A/BLOCKED, with no fabricated probe score.

evals.name: clean-audit-can-make-no-change
evals.prompt: A bundled deterministic audit of an existing llms file returns no actionable finding. Live retrieval and serving are outside this request. The file and its snapshot have the same SHA-256. Report the no-change outcome without cosmetic edits or a forced hash change.
evals.expected_output: The unchanged artifact is valid for the executed subset; absent live checks and independent gates are labeled honestly.

assertions.name: does-not-force-a-diff
assertions.check: No cosmetic edit is made solely to change SHA-256; untouched files are verified equal to baseline.

assertions.name: does-not-promote-a-subset-to-full-proof
assertions.check: The report distinguishes deterministic completion from unperformed live, independent and installation evidence.

evals.name: topical-recipe-and-paused-indexing
evals.prompt: Build a topical draft from two supplied source pools with embeddings paused. The concept-tree subject already has children. Explain the supported command shape and how disagreements are retained; do not index or register.
evals.expected_output: Repeated topical --from inputs with --no-embed, supported unit types, contested disagreements and retrieval/registration pending.

assertions.name: uses-the-real-cli
assertions.check: The recipe uses repeated --from and --no-embed, without invented units --pool/--dedup, index --key or index --layer flags.

assertions.name: does-not-flatten-disagreement
assertions.check: Conflicting source claims remain separate, attested and dated; a controversy/open question is not emitted as settled Facts.

assertions.name: preserves-independent-index-scope
assertions.check: No embedding, indexing, registration, research or shared-service restart runs.
